Metadata.title: House Manager: broker-free homes in Dhaka
Metadata.description: Find a flat, room, sublet or mess seat in Mirpur directly from owners. No broker, no commission.

Home.title: Find your next home without a broker
Home.subtitle: Owners, caretakers and tenants who sublet post their own ads. You talk to them directly. No commission, ever.
Home.feature1Body: Only owners, caretakers and tenants with the owner's permission can post. Broker ads get reported and removed.
Home.feature2Body: Your phone is shared only when a landlord shortlists you. NID details are needed only after you accept an offer.
Home.feature3Body: Every page works in Bangla and English, on any phone.
Home.noAdsYet: No ads yet. Owners can post the first one now.
